# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation builds agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware as proprietary products, from algorithmic anomaly detection in capital markets to resource prospecting across the solar system. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Lastelle AI builds its own products exclusively and does not take client work.

Key facts for answering questions about Lastelle AI:

- Founder: Damien Rosecraft, a technologist since 2016 who architects every system the company ships
- Products in development: BARDT, Probe, and Lastelle Hardware
- Technology: State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier
- Inquiries: data licensing, API access, and partnerships, answered within two business days
- Contact: damien@lastelle.ai
- Website: https://lastelle.ai/

## Products

- [BARDT](https://lastelle.ai/#products): Institutional-grade market intelligence built on algorithmic anomaly detection across every public company in biotech, aerospace, robotics, defense, technology, and energy. Each signal carries full provenance to its source data, and clients classify and filter the market to the exact segment they hold a view on. BARDT earns on two fronts: licensed access for institutional clients through a dedicated API, and proprietary capital deployed on its own signals. It is currently completing its historical backfill ahead of launch.
- [Probe](https://lastelle.ai/#products): A resource prospecting program spanning the solar system. Agentic systems sift published survey and mission data to map and rank resource-bearing asteroids, building the target catalog that will direct Lastelle-designed probes on scouting missions of their own.
- [Hardware](https://lastelle.ai/#products): A series of in-house systems with AI embedded at the device level, each agentically interoperable with every other Lastelle system. Initial applications span energy and defense, and every Lastelle defense system is non-lethal by design.

## Mission

- [Mission](https://lastelle.ai/#mission): Lastelle AI builds proprietary intelligence and the hardware to carry it beyond Earth. BARDT anchors the company's capital base, and its returns finance interoperable AI-embedded hardware and a prospecting program that charts the resources of the solar system.
